panels.description: Per assignee, counts issues created in the window split by status into To Do, In Progress and Done.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''),
         i.assignee_id
       ), '-', ' ')                                          AS developer,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'TODO'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `To Do`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `In Progress`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Done
FROM issue_assignees ia
JOIN issues i           ON i.id = ia.issue_id
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = ia.assignee_id 
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND i.original_type not like '%bug%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id}) 
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
GROUP BY developer
ORDER BY (`To Do` + `In Progress` + Done) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Issues By Status

panels.description: Counts issues currently in OPEN original_status per assignee, with no time window applied.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),         ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''),
         '(unassigned)'
       ), '-', ' ')                                                  AS Developer,
       COUNT(*)                                                      AS `Work In Progress`
FROM issues i
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = i.assignee_id AND a.id IN ( $developer_id )
WHERE i.original_status = 'OPEN'
  AND i.id LIKE 'github:%'
GROUP BY developer
ORDER BY `Work In Progress` DESC;

panels.title: Current Work In Progress

panels.description: Time series counting DONE issues per assignee, bucketed by resolution date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(i.resolution_date, ${interval})                     AS time,
       REPLACE(COALESCE(
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''),
         '(unassigned)'
       ), '-', ' ')                                              AS metric,
       COUNT(*)                                                  AS value
FROM issues i
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = i.assignee_id AND a.id IN ( $developer_id )
WHERE i.status = 'DONE'
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Issues Closed

panels.description: Per assignee, counts issues by mapped type category and splits them into Planned versus Adhoc based on whether their sprint has a start date. Type mapping is keyword matching on the raw GitHub issue type/label text, not the connection's scope-config regex -- a repo whose labels don't literally contain a bucket's keyword will show 0 for that category even though the issues exist.

targets.rawSql:
WITH type_map AS (
  SELECT original_type,
         CASE
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%bug%'
             OR original_type LIKE '%issue%'         THEN 'Bugs'
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%documentation%' THEN 'Documentation'
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%R&D%'           THEN 'R&D'
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%review%'        THEN 'Reviews'
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%refactor%'
             OR original_type LIKE '%debt%'
             OR original_type LIKE '%enhancement%'
             OR original_type LIKE '%improvement%'   THEN 'Refactoring'
           WHEN original_type LIKE '%task%'          THEN 'Tasks'
           ELSE 'Unclassified'
         END AS category
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT original_type FROM issues) d
)
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name),     ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''),
         '(unassigned)'
       ), '-', ' ')                       AS Developer,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Bugs')          AS Bugs,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Documentation') AS Documentation,
       SUM(tm.category = 'R&D')           AS `R&D`,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Reviews')       AS Reviews,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Refactoring')   AS Refactoring,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Tasks')         AS Tasks,
       SUM(tm.category = 'Other')         AS Other,
       COUNT(*)                           AS Total,
       COUNT(IF (s.started_date IS NULL, 1, NULL)) AS Adhoc,
       COUNT(IF (s.started_date IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL)) AS Planned
FROM issues i
JOIN type_map tm ON tm.original_type <=> i.original_type
LEFT JOIN sprint_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = i.assignee_id AND a.id IN ( $developer_id )
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
GROUP BY Developer 
ORDER BY Developer ASC

panels.title: Issue Type Mix Per Developer

list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'github:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition:
SELECT CONCAT(r.name, '--', r.id) AS text 
FROM project_mapping pm 
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'github:%'
AND pm.project_name IN ( $project )
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- PR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, scoped through boards (github board ids match repo ids)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
)
SELECT Name FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(
           REPLACE(COALESCE(
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
             '(unmapped)'
           ), '-', ' '),
           '--', a.id) AS Name
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY Name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
